summary: Iteration 3 backend testing of JOBBY Sprint 3 (categories in DB with admin toggle, 3 roles, simulated KYC, request status flow pending→matched→confirmed→in_progress→completed[+disputed], wallet with payment-method/bank-account, Trust Score engine + events + admin recalc, X-Admin-Token gating). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_jobby_sprint3.py — 25/25 pytests passed against the public preview URL. Categories return grouped {standard:9, proximity:16, payment:4} + providers_online + manifesto. Admin GET/POST /admin/categories properly requires X-Admin-Token (403 without/with wrong); toggle flips active and removes/reappears the category from GET /categories. Toggled 'sarta' off then back on — DB verified all 29 categories active at end of run. Roles switchable via PUT /profile with services persisted. Verification start->pending, complete->verified + kyc subscore=100. Wallet PUT payment-method persists; IBAN masked to last-6 (starts with '*'). /wallet/add and /payments reject amount<=0 (fixed since iter 2). Full status flow succeeds: mission created pending, bot auto-accepts within ~10s → matched, /select → booking confirmed, /start → in_progress + check_in_on_time=true, /complete → completed. Trust: after review provider_score>0 with all 8 subscores and 'review' trust_events entry; rate-client logs client_trust_events + non-zero client_score; dispute recomputes both and logs events on both sides; kyc subscore=100 after verification. Admin /admin/trust/recalc returns recalculated>=1 without token → 403. Auth guards: all new endpoints return 401 without Bearer.

minor.issue: No ownership check — any authenticated user with a valid Bearer can advance any booking to in_progress and flip check_in_on_time=true. Should verify caller is booking.provider_id.
No ownership check — any authenticated user can mark any booking completed, which also triggers recalc_provider_trust for another user's provider.
No ownership check — any authenticated user can post a review as if they were the customer. Should verify user_id == booking.customer_id.
No ownership check — should verify user_id == booking.provider_id. Also recalc_client_trust is called twice in the handler (once before, once after log_trust_event) — remove the first redundant call.
No ownership check; any authenticated user can dispute any booking (sets status=disputed and damages both trust scores).
Still no check that caller is mission.customer_id (raised in iter 1 & 2, still open).
Ownership checks now present — verified reading the code (convo.user_id == user_id). Was flagged in iter 2, now fixed.

action_items: Add ownership guards to booking lifecycle endpoints (/start, /complete, /review, /rate-client, /dispute) and to /missions/{id}/select — currently any authenticated user can drive any booking's state and mangle trust scores.
Remove the duplicate recalc_client_trust call inside POST /bookings/{id}/rate-client (called both before and after log_trust_event).
server.py is now ~830 lines (over the 700-line guideline) — consider splitting into routers (auth, categories, missions, bookings, wallet, chat, trust, admin) before Sprint 4.
Replace deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') with FastAPI lifespan context manager.

Seed script (seed_categories) uses $setOnInsert only — editing STANDARD_SERVICES/PROXIMITY_BUSINESS/PAYMENT_SERVICES in code won't update existing category docs (emoji/label/questions). Consider $set of non-active fields on every startup, or add a migration route.
critical_code_review_comments: Booking lifecycle endpoints lack authorization checks — any Bearer holder can advance/complete/review/dispute someone else's booking (see minor issues).
rate_client handler calls recalc_client_trust twice; the first invocation's result is overwritten and log_trust_event is fed the pre-log score (works but confusing).

verification/complete calls both recalc_provider_trust and recalc_client_trust regardless of the user's role — fine for the one-account-switchable model but redundant work if the user is only a client.
get_categories groups by kind by hardcoding 'standard' as fallback bucket — any future 'kind' typo would silently be misclassified.
Deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event still used (also flagged iter 1 & 2).

success_rate.frontend: not tested (per request — Emergent Google OAuth cannot be automated)

seed_data_creation: Tests insert synthetic TEST_ users + user_sessions directly into MongoDB (test_database) to obtain Bearer tokens, then cleanup users/sessions/missions/bookings/transactions/service_requests/trust_events/client_trust_events/reviews/disputes after each test. For Trust tests, a temporary session is inserted for the auto-accepting bot provider to inspect its /api/trust view. Bot providers seeded at server startup are reused. Category toggle test flips 'sarta' off then on — final DB state verified: 29 categories, none inactive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE_URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Auth = Emergent Google OAuth; for protected endpoints insert users+user_sessions directly in Mongo (see _mk_user helper). Admin endpoints require header X-Admin-Token=jobby-admin-7c2f9a (from backend/.env ADMIN_TOKEN). Category catalog is now in DB (collection 'categories', 29 docs: 9 standard, 16 proximity, 4 payment); toggling active removes it from GET /categories. Trust engine: PROVIDER_WEIGHTS has 8 subscores (kyc, punctuality, quality, communication, cancellation, completed, dispute, tenure); CLIENT_WEIGHTS has 7 (identity, education, brief, payment, cancellation, tips, reviews). Provider trust recalced on: /verification/complete, /profile role change, /bookings/{id}/complete, /bookings/{id}/review, /bookings/{id}/dispute, /admin/trust/recalc. trust_events (provider side) and client_trust_events (client side) log 'review', 'client_rated', 'dispute' with score_after and meta. Bots auto-accept any category (is_bot bypass in create_mission). Bot auto-accept latency: 2-9s per bot.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all iter-3 tests green. Only hardening remarks: (1) booking lifecycle & mission-select endpoints missing ownership guards (highest-priority remaining hole); (2) minor double-recalc in rate-client; (3) server.py past 700 lines — refactor recommended before Sprint 4.
